regime_read: Convergence favors AI compute, enterprise technology and semiconductor infrastructure, with the clearest non-extended alignment in NVDA, IBM, MU and MSFT; PLTR also aligns but is already extended. The track record is 2-for-2 but far too small to support more than provisional, mostly low conviction.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号集中于AI算力、企业科技与半导体基础设施，其中NVDA、IBM、MU和MSFT的非超涨共振最清晰；PLTR也有共振，但已明显超涨。历史记录虽为2次命中2次，但样本过小，因此整体判断仍属暂定，置信度以低为主。

theses.thesis: Six-channel convergence combines model-ecosystem momentum, rising developer activity, a patent cluster and uniformly bullish analyst signals, while disclosed holdings by Nancy Pelosi, Marjorie Taylor Greene and Michael McCaul broaden the influence signal [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The Trump-linked buy signal supports the direction, although retail attention makes part of the alignment sentiment-driven [trump] [retail_buzz].
theses.thesis_zh: 六渠道共振涵盖模型生态动量、开发者活跃度上升、专利集群和一致看多的分析师信号；Nancy Pelosi、Marjorie Taylor Greene及Michael McCaul的披露持仓进一步扩大了影响力信号覆盖面 [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。特朗普关联买入信号支持方向，但散户关注也意味着部分共振由情绪驱动 [trump] [retail_buzz]。
second_order: MU — memory demand is a downstream requirement of expanding AI compute infrastructure.
AMAT — semiconductor-capacity investment can benefit indirectly from sustained accelerator and memory demand.
CEG — data-center electricity demand can support nuclear and other firm-power providers.
theses.dissent: Retail buzz and political holdings may be crowded or stale, while the pack contains no contract, insider-buying or earnings-demand confirmation.

falsifier.text: Developer and model-download momentum reverses while analyst signals cease to be broadly bullish.

theses.thesis: IBM has the most operationally grounded mix: sharply accelerating federal-contract activity, positive insider-purchase intensity, developer/model momentum and a large patent cluster [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. These channels span customer demand, management behavior and technical output, while modest relative strength suggests the signal has not already been chased.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM拥有最偏基本面执行层的信号组合：联邦合同活动大幅加速、内部人购买强度为正、开发者及模型动量，以及较大的专利集群 [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]。这些渠道分别覆盖客户需求、管理层行为和技术产出，而相对强度仍温和，说明市场尚未明显追涨。
second_order: MSFT — broader enterprise AI and hybrid-cloud spending can reinforce demand across major platform vendors.
PLTR — faster federal technology procurement can benefit adjacent government-data and analytics platforms.
theses.dissent: Earnings are only seven days away, and the prior earnings-surprise reading was flat, so near-term execution could overwhelm the alternative-data signal.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration normalizes and insider-purchase intensity disappears without corresponding growth in enterprise demand.

theses.thesis: MU's six-channel cluster joins accelerating government grants, positive insider-purchase intensity and a substantial patent footprint, creating a tangible capital-support, management-behavior and innovation alignment [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]. Bullish Stocktwits activity adds confirmation but is lower-quality sentiment evidence [stocktwits_bull]; the Trump-linked sell signal directly tempers conviction [trump].
theses.thesis_zh: MU的六渠道集群将政府补助加速、积极的内部人购买强度和较大的专利储备结合起来，形成资本支持、管理层行为与创新活动的共振 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]。Stocktwits看多情绪提供额外确认，但属于质量较低的情绪证据 [stocktwits_bull]；特朗普关联卖出信号则直接压低置信度 [trump]。
second_order: AMAT — stronger memory investment can raise demand for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
NVDA — adequate advanced-memory supply is an enabling input for AI accelerator deployment.
theses.dissent: The Trump-linked sell signal conflicts with the bullish cluster, and grant acceleration does not by itself establish durable commercial memory demand.

falsifier.text: Government-grant momentum and insider-purchase intensity weaken while memory-linked commercial demand fails to emerge.

theses.thesis: Consumer application demand, model-download momentum, a large developer footprint and patent activity align with the strategic OpenAI partnership [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman]. The Trump-linked buy signal and Bill Ackman affiliation add influence support [trump] [actor:Bill Ackman], but relative performance is already near the desk's extension threshold and earnings are close, so the entry case is marginal rather than aggressive.
theses.thesis_zh: 消费者应用需求、模型下载动量、庞大的开发者生态和专利活动，与其OpenAI战略合作关系形成共振 [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [actor:Sam Altman]。特朗普关联买入信号与Bill Ackman关联提供影响力层面的支持 [trump] [actor:Bill Ackman]，但相对表现已接近本桌的超涨阈值且财报临近，因此入场逻辑仅属勉强成立，不宜激进。
second_order: NVDA — cloud AI utilization can translate into accelerator demand.
CEG — expanding cloud and AI workloads can increase demand for dependable data-center power.
IBM — enterprise adoption can broaden the market for hybrid-cloud and AI integration services.
theses.dissent: Relative strength is already close to the extension cutoff, and strong application ratings or developer activity may not translate into incremental profit at the approaching earnings report.

falsifier.text: Application demand and model-download momentum roll over while the next earnings report shows no corresponding AI or cloud operating leverage.

theses.thesis: Federal-contract acceleration and developer momentum provide operational support, while disclosed political and fund affiliations plus bullish retail channels broaden the signal [gov_contract_accel] [github_momentum] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. However, relative performance is far beyond the extension threshold, so the evidence supports watching for a reset rather than pursuing the current price.
theses.thesis_zh: 联邦合同加速和开发者动量构成经营层面的支持，而披露的政治人物与基金关联以及看多散户渠道扩大了信号覆盖面 [gov_contract_accel] [github_momentum] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。但其相对表现已远超超涨阈值，因此当前证据只支持等待价格重置，而不支持追涨。
second_order: IBM — continued federal technology modernization can lift adjacent government and enterprise contractors.
MSFT — greater deployment of data-intensive government software can support cloud-infrastructure consumption.
theses.dissent: The strongest non-contract signals are crowded retail sentiment and affiliations, while extreme relative strength leaves substantial reversal risk.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration reverses and developer momentum weakens before price and relative strength reset.

theses.thesis: Phase 3 trial starts, FDA approvals and label expansions align across development and commercialization milestones [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion]. Negative relative performance means the signal is not extended, but the channels are concentrated within one regulatory-clinical complex rather than truly independent, keeping conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: 三期临床试验启动、FDA批准及适应症标签扩展，在研发和商业化里程碑上形成一致信号 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion]。相对表现为负，说明价格并未超涨；但这些渠道都集中在同一监管与临床体系内，独立性有限，因此置信度保持较低。
second_order: Clinical-research organizations — a broad Phase 3 pipeline implies demand for trial execution and monitoring services.
Specialty diagnostics — label expansion and late-stage development can increase companion-testing demand.
theses.dissent: One reported clinical halt and the shared regulatory origin of the signals reduce their independence and leave substantial trial-specific risk.

falsifier.text: Additional clinical halts emerge or label-expansion activity fails to translate into commercial uptake.
